translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Nǝb̃ol p̃usan husur navensus tosǝŋavur

Beti aYesu isor husur natǝlmaman san dan nǝmav hum nakiŋ, ike, “Datolǝboi datb̃enǝnoṽ hǝn natohan pipihabǝlan aGot len nǝmav, mai navensus tosǝŋavur lotolav nam̃ial salit, yar van hǝn lǝb̃ebubur mai naulum̃an b̃ilah.
Galit erim lovi hoṽon, erim lukad namitisau hǝn nǝmauran tonor.
Navensus lotovi hoṽon, lupat nam̃ial salit gail be lǝsǝpat naoil ideh.
Navensus lotokad namitisau hǝn nǝmauran tonor, lupat nam̃ial salit gail mai lupat nab̃iliwai hǝn naoil gail am.
“Nǝboŋ naulum̃an b̃ilah tovǝlo, navensus gail p̃isi losusuh metanoṽ, gol lupatmari.
Tub̃loh len mariug nǝkaian sua evi mǝhat, ‘Mǝteris! Naulum̃an b̃ilah bogai! Gǝm risi, ke “Ivoi,” maii!’
Ale navensus gail lule mǝhat, logut kuv nadurinen nawik hǝn nam̃ial salit gail.
Be torim lotovi hoṽon lukel mai torim lotokad nalǝboian ke, ‘Lav naoil ideh samit mai ginamito, husur nam̃ial sinamit gail lǝsǝpaŋ savoi, dereh limat.’
Be alat lotokad nalǝboian luke, ‘Ao, datb̃igol b̃imaienan, dereh naoil tem̃idol hǝn gidat p̃isi. Mitia ṽur ideh samito len naim p̃urp̃ur.’
Ale luvan hǝn lǝb̃eṽuri. Be nǝboŋ lotoyar van sal, naulum̃an b̃ilah evisi. Beti navensus torim lotoutaut tia, lutah maii, lob̃is lohoim hǝn nǝlahan. Ale nǝvanuan nauman ekǝkol gat nabopita.
Nǝboŋ namityal topair, navensus lotoṽur naoil lotǝlmam, lukai ke, ‘Nasub̃, Nasub̃, sǝŋav hǝn nabopita hǝn ginamito!’
Ris tosor var galit ke, ‘Nukel nakitinan mai gamito, nǝsalǝboi kas gamito.’”
AYesu imaris kotov nǝb̃ol enan ike, “Imagenan, mǝtehulahul hǝn asike mǝtb̃esum̃an navensus lotovi hoṽon, husur mǝtsalǝboi nǝmariboŋ o namityal hǝn natǝlmaman sagw.”
Nǝb̃ol p̃usan husur naslev totor mai nǝvat

AYesu isor tǝtas husur natǝlmaman san, ike, “Natohan pipihabǝlan aGot len nǝmav imaiegai: Ikad avan sua toutaut hǝn b̃ivan len nǝyaran sua. Ekis naslev san gail gǝmai ale eriŋ natit san gail len navǝlalito.
Ilav nǝvat mai galit ṽisusua tonor hǝn namitisau salito. Ilav nǝtalent torim mai naslev sua, ilav nǝtalent toru mai naslev sual am, ale ilav tosua mai naslev togon.
Ale vǝha-sua ŋai eriŋ naut enan len nǝyaran san.
Naslev tokad nǝtalent torim eum lan van ikad erim am.
Len naṽide tomaienan, naslev tokad toru, eum lan van ikad eru am.
Be aten tokad nǝtalent tosua, evivile, ehir nab̃ur len tan ale itavun susuan nǝvat simasta san.
“Idareh buni amasta sislev galenan etǝlmam hǝn b̃elǝboi nǝsa lotogole len nǝvat san.
Naslev, amasta tolav nǝtalent torim maii, ipat nǝtalent torim am gǝm hǝni ike, ‘Nasub̃, gulav nǝtalent torim mai ginau, ale len torim enan nopisan erim eg am.’

Amasta ikel maii ke, ‘Nauman sam̃ ikab! Govi naslev tovoi, todaŋ len ginau. Gudaŋ len natit tokǝkereh notoriŋi len navǝlam̃, imagenan dereh nitabtabuh len gaiug hǝn nǝb̃eriŋ natit tisob̃ur len navǝlam̃. Gegǝmai, gehǝhaṽur mai ginau!’
“Beti naslev, amasta tolav nǝtalent toru maii, egǝm hǝni ike, ‘Nasub̃, gulav nǝtalent toru mai ginau, ale len toru enan nopisan eru eg am.’

Amasta ikel maii ke, ‘Nauman sam̃ ikab! Govi naslev tovoi, todaŋ len ginau. Gudaŋ len natit tokǝkereh notoriŋi len navǝlam̃, imaienan dereh nitabtabuh len gaiug hǝn nǝb̃eriŋ natit tisob̃ur len navǝlam̃. Gegǝmai, gehǝhaṽur mai ginau!’

“Beti naslev, amasta tolav nǝtalent tosua maii, egǝm hǝni ike, ‘Nasub̃, nolǝboii tia ke govi naulum̃an totaltal, len nǝmatuan gulav nǝhanian dan naut gǝsǝmabule lan, gotǝtariv wit len naut gǝsǝdaŋdaŋ namisurhute lan.
Imagenan nomǝtahw, ale nua susuan nǝtalent sam̃ len tan. Nǝvat sam̃ bogai.’

Amasta san isor vari ke, ‘Govi naslev tosa vǝsa gotovekan. Gǝb̃inau ke notovi naulum̃an totaltal, gǝb̃inau ke notolav nǝhanian dan naut nǝsǝmabule lan, gǝb̃inau ke nototǝtariv wit len naut nǝsǝdaŋdaŋ namisurhute lan,
imabe gǝsariŋ nǝvat sagw len nalulutar? Gǝtagol tomaienan, nǝboŋ nototǝlmam, nǝtǝlav nǝvat sagw mai naintǝres han.’
Ale ikel mai nǝvanuan nauman san gail ke, ‘Lav kuv nǝtalent dan ategai, lavi mai atea tokad tosǝŋavur.
Husur avan ideh toum tovoi len nǝsa tokade, dereh nilav tisob̃ur am maii hǝn b̃epul hǝni. Be avan ideh tom̃idol, avan ideh saum savoi len nǝsa tokade, dereh nilav kuv tokǝkereh gai tokade, dani.
Naslev sagol natideh savoi, bar hǝni vivile len nǝmargobut, len naut enan dereh tikad nǝtaŋan mai na-desdes-batriṽoriṽ-an.’
Napǝpehwan namǝkot hǝn navoian dan nǝsaan
“Nǝboŋ aNatun Nǝvanuan b̃egǝmai len namǝnas hǝn nǝyalyalan san, mai aŋel gail p̃isi, dereh tebǝtah len nab̃iltihai bǝtbǝtah san toyalyal hum nakiŋ.
Beti naluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile gail p̃isi dereh lib̃onb̃on len nǝhon. Ale dereh tepǝpehun galito hum nǝvanuan nasipsip topǝpehun nasipsip gail dan nǝnani gail.
Dereh teriŋ nasipsip gail len nǝmatu san mai nǝnani gail len nǝmair.

Beti nakiŋ dereh tikel mai alat len nǝmatu san ke, ‘Gamit, aTǝmagw tovoi buni hǝn gamito, mǝtegǝmai! Mititoh pipihabǝlan aTǝmagw len naut toutaut hǝni tia m̃os gamito len natub̃atan, nǝboŋ togol navile a pan.
Husur nǝboŋ notomalkǝkat, mǝtovǝŋan ginau; nǝboŋ notomaduh, mǝtulav nǝwai mai ginau; nǝboŋ notovi metb̃os, mǝtokis ginau vi lohoim samito;
nǝboŋ notomalmal hǝn nahurabat, mǝtukol nahurabat len ginau; nǝboŋ notomǝsah, mǝtokǝtkǝta tǝban ginau; nǝboŋ nototoh len naim bǝbaŋis, mǝtogǝm, m̃ǝdoŋ tǝban ginau.’
Beti alat lotonor dereh lisor vari ke, ‘Nasub̃, namtoris gotomalkǝkat namtovǝŋan gaiug ŋais? Namtoris gotomaduh namtulav nǝwai mai gaiug ŋais?
Namtoris gaiug gotovi metb̃os namtous gaiug vi lohoim sinamit ŋais? Namtoris gotomalmal hǝn nahurabat namtukol nahurabat len gaiug ŋais?
Namtoris gotomǝsah o namtom̃ǝdoŋ tǝban gaiug ŋais len naim bǝbaŋis?’
Ale nakiŋ dereh tisor var galit ke, ‘Nukel nakitinan mai gamit ke, nǝboŋ mǝttogole van hǝn nǝbathudud ideh sagw tovi ut kǝmas ŋai, mǝtugole van hǝn ginau.’

“Beti dereh tipair, tikel mai alat len nǝmair san ke, ‘Gamit, aGot togol nǝmauran samit tosa vǝsa, mǝtevi tut dan ginau, mǝtevi lan nǝhab topaŋ vi sutuai aGot toutaut hǝni tia m̃os natǝmat mai aŋel san gail!
Husur nǝboŋ notomalkǝkat, mǝtsavǝŋan ginau; nǝboŋ notomaduh, mǝtsǝlav nǝwai mai ginau;
nǝboŋ notovi metb̃os, mǝtsakis ginau vi lohoim samito; nǝboŋ notomalmal hǝn nahurabat, mǝtsakol nahurabat ideh len ginau; nǝboŋ notomǝsah o nototoh len naim bǝbaŋis, mǝtsam̃ǝdoŋ tǝban ginau.’
Beti dereh lisor vari ke, ‘Nasub̃, ŋais namtoris gaiug gotomalkǝkat, o gotomaduh, o gotovi metb̃os, o gotomalmal, o gotomǝsah, o gototoh len naim bǝbaŋis be namtsavi tarhǝt sam̃?’
Ale dereh tisor var galit ke, ‘Nukel nakitinan mai gamit ke, nǝboŋ mǝtsagole van hǝn nǝbathudud ideh sagw tovi ut kǝmas ŋai, mǝtsagole van hǝn ginau.’
Beti alatenan dereh levi tut, vi lan nǝpanismen topat vi sutuai, be alat lotonor levi lan nǝmauran vi sutuai.”

footnotes.text: 25.1 Len nasoruan ta Kris sake aYesu isor husur natǝlmaman san dan nǝmav, be nasoruan enan ipat gegai hǝn b̃isor vǝsvǝsai nǝb̃ol p̃usan tohusuri. Navensus gail hum ma lotovi galevis len naluṽoh sivensus b̃ilah, ale luvan hǝn lǝb̃ebubur mai naulum̃an b̃ilah mai naluṽoh san. Nǝboŋ naluṽoh toru arb̃ib̃on, nǝlahan etub̃at.
25.15 Nǝtalent esua ŋai evi nap̃urp̃uran hǝn nauman hǝn nasihau tovi 15.
